[[Rocius]] is a [[Priest of Balthazar]] without dialogue. 

==Locations==
*[[Crystal Desert]]
**{{NPC location|Tomb of the Primeval Kings}}

==Notes==
*This is the only Priest of Balthazar that doesn't use the model of a [[Zaishen Order|Zaishen]] priest, and the only one in a PvE area without competitive elements.
{{bug|Rocius has no dialogue and the PvP unlock panel won't open, making it impossible to spend any [[Balthazar faction]].}}

==Trivia==
*Rocius was once a working priest, when Tomb of the Primeval Kings was an outpost for the Global Tournament. When that was moved to the [[Battle Isles]], the PvP oriented NPCs were removed, including Rocius. Later, a mistake in an update reintroduced all the PvP NPCs to Tombs, which was later rectified in another update, subsequently removing them. However, Rocius remained and has been a part of it since then.
